TECHNICAL NOTE

Floating vs. Trunnion-Mounted Ball Valves

A floating ball valve uses line pressure to push the ball against the downstream seat, providing a compact design. A trunnion-mounted ball valve supports the ball through upper and lower stems, making it suitable for larger sizes and higher pressure.

Engineering guidance

Before the final model is selected, an applications engineer should review the full piping conditions, control logic, and project specifications. A standard product is only the starting point; the right match is what delivers reliable operation.
